geometry_contract: Both surface roles preserve identical geometry, spacing, typography, scale, aspect ratio, visible bounds, and internal padding.

A vector master is accepted only when it genuinely exists and all lettering and marks are outlined paths; SVG text and linked raster images are rejected.

acceptance_qa: Both required PNG files exist for each brand and carry explicit designer approval.
Each PNG has a transparent background and no mockup, texture, shadow, or environmental effect.
The light- and dark-surface files have matching canvas dimensions, aspect ratio, scale, visible bounds, and internal padding.
An overlay test shows identical silhouettes and placement except for approved surface colour changes.
Friiites reads FR + exactly III + TES and preserves the gold signature accent.
Deano's files are dedicated horizontal wordmarks, or an explicit designer decision reclassifies and approves a horizontal combined lockup for these roles.
Any supplied vector master contains outlined paths only and no SVG text, font dependency, linked image, or embedded raster.
Metadata records brand, role, intended surface, approval status, master filename, dimensions, usage notes, and minimum-size notes.
No Level One acceptance depends on food photography, packaging, or scene imagery.
